description: Declare a Temporal Workflow as an external Dagster asset. Pair with temporal_workflow_sensor when Temporal owns the schedule.

workflow_type.description: Temporal Workflow class name (registered on the worker).
workflow_type.label: Workflow Type

workflow_id.description: Specific Workflow ID this asset represents (for a fixed workflow_id, not template-derived).
workflow_id.label: Workflow ID

schedule_id.description: Temporal Schedule ID (when the workflow is fired by a Temporal Schedule).
schedule_id.label: Schedule ID

task_queue.description: Task queue the workflow's worker polls (for context / docs).
task_queue.label: Task Queue

temporal_ui_url.description: Temporal Web UI base URL — surfaces as a clickable link in the catalog.
temporal_ui_url.label: Temporal Ui URL
